mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payroll ( payroll_code, company_code, user_id, payroll_period_code, payroll_period, payroll_type, bonus_method, bonus_rate, bonus_amount, payroll_name, payroll_start_date, payroll_end_date, payroll_date ) VALUES ( fn_make_date_code('PAYROLL'), #{companyCode}, #{userId}, #{payrollPeriodCode}, #{payrollPeriod}, 'j2', #{bonusMethod}, #{bonusRate}, #{bonusAmount}, #{payrollName}, #{payrollStartDate}, #{payrollEndDate}, #{payrollDate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT um.user_id, um.user_name, dm.dept_name AS dept FROM tb_user_master um JOIN tb_dept_master dm ON um.dept = dm.dept_code WHERE 1=1 AND um.company_code = #{companyCode} AND um.leave_date IS NULL
AND um.user_name like '%' || #{userName} || '%'
AND um.dept like '%' || #{dept} || '%'
ORDER BY um.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_pay_management ( user_pay_management_code, payroll_code, company_code, user_id, pay_period, pay_date, salary, bonus, overtime_allowance, night_allowance, holiday_allowance, family_allowance, meal_allowance, total_allowance, total_payment, income_tax, national_pension, employment_insurance, health_insurance, long_time_care_insurance, local_income_tax, total_deduction, net_pay, absence ) VALUES ( fn_make_date_code('USER_PAY_MANAGEMENT'), #{payrollCode}, (SELECT company_code FROM tb_user_master WHERE user_id = #{userId}), #{userId}, (SELECT payroll_period FROM tb_payroll WHERE payroll_code = #{payrollCode}), #{payrollDate}, #{salary}, #{bonus}, #{overtime}, #{night}, #{holiday}, #{family}, #{meal}, #{totalAllowance}, #{totalPaymentAmount}, #{incomeTax}, #{nationalPension}, #{employmentInsurance}, #{healthInsurance}, #{longTimeCareInsurance}, #{localIncomeTax}, #{totalDeductionAmount}, #{netPay}, #{absence} )
